title: frmtmb for brms users
text: brm(...) becomes frm(...); priors, chains, warmup. REML = TRUE replaces priors small-sample correction variance components. Posterior summaries become ML estimates: fixef() returns point estimates, confint() gives Wald profile intervals, anova() gives likelihood-ratio tests, AIC()/BIC() replace loo(). posterior_predict() becomes simulate(); conditional_effects() implemented yet (use predict(newdata, se.fit = TRUE) grid, emmeans). supported: mi(), (), mo(), gp(), cs(), mixture(), ar()/ma() residual autocorrelation terms (use ar1() random-effect structure), category-specific effects.

title: frmtmb for brms users
text: Genuine prior information, full posterior uncertainty derived quantities, models outside latent-Gaussian/Laplace class (mixtures, discrete latents), loo-based model comparison. practical workflow model screening frmtmb final fit brms; as_tmbstan(fit) also runs NUTS frmtmb objective directly.

code: set.seed(1) d <- data.frame(x = runif(200, 0, 5)) d$y <- 2.5 * exp(-0.7 * d$x) + rnorm(200, 0, 0.15) nlfit <- frm(bf(y ~ a * exp(-b * x), a ~ 1, b ~ 1, nl = TRUE) +                gaussian(),              data = d, start = list(beta = c(1, 0.3))) unlist(fixef(nlfit)[c("a", "b")]) #> a.(Intercept) b.(Intercept)  #>     2.5067769     0.7022003

title: Formula-Based Regression Models via RTMB
text: Early development (v0.5). Current scope: Nonlinear formulas (nl = TRUE): arbitrary R expressions named parameters, full predictor grammar (bf(y ~ * exp(-b * x), ~ 1 + (1 | g), b ~ 1, nl = TRUE)) Custom families plain R functions (custom_family()), AD safety checker (check_custom_family()) Ordinal regression: cumulative(logit/probit) ordered thresholds, ordered-factor responses, random effects Censoring truncation: y | cens(c) ~ ..., y | trunc(lb = 0) (gaussian, lognormal) emmeans support tmbstan bridge (as_tmbstan()) MCMC objective Function--scalar (functional response) regression via long-format + smooth representation, validated mgcv Multivariate models: mvbf(), bf() + bf(), mvbind(); family per response; residual correlation (rescor = TRUE, gaussian); brms |ID| syntax random-effect correlation across responses ((1 | p | g) several formulas) - open glmmTMB issue #1267 Matrix responses: multinomial(K) takes n x K count matrix per-category linear predictors Zero-inflation hurdle: zero_inflated_poisson(), zero_inflated_negbinomial(), hurdle_poisson(), full zi ~ / hu ~ formulas Distributional regression: every distributional parameter takes formula full predictor grammar, including random effects smooths (bf(y ~ s(x) + (1 | g), sigma ~ s(z) + (1 | g))), fixed constant (bf(y ~ x, sigma = 1)) mgcv smooths s() t2() linear predictor; smoothing parameters estimated variance components marginal ML/REML (matches mgcv::gam(method = "ML")) Families: gaussian, poisson, binomial (trials()), Gamma, lognormal, student, negbinomial, nbinom1, beta, tweedie, compois lme4-style random effects: (1 | g), (1 + x | g), (x || g), us(), diag(), homdiag(), cs(), ar1() covariance structures weights() addition term offset() ML REML Methods: summary, logLik, AIC, vcov, fixef, ranef, VarCorr, predict (newdata, se.fit, re.form), fitted, residuals, simulate, confint (Wald, profile, uniroot), anova (LRT), update, diagnose See SPEC.md full design roadmap: ordinal families cens()/trunc() (v0.4.x), nonlinear formulas custom families plain R functions (v0.5).

title: frmtmb specification
text: frmtmb R package formula-based regression modeling brms grammar frequentist backend. fits models maximum likelihood Laplace approximation latent effects, RTMB. use MCMC compile code run time. Status: design specification; v0.5 implemented (v0.4.x: cumulative ordinal threshold extra-parameters, cens()/trunc() CDF-carrying families; v0.5: nl = TRUE nonlinear formulas, custom_family() check_custom_family(), emmeans registration, as_tmbstan(); plus predvars freezing, rank-deficiency column dropping, edge-case suite mined lme4/glmmTMB/brms issue history - see dev/test-backlog.md). Function--scalar functional regression works long-format + smooth representation (validated vs mgcv); scalar--function terms (mgcv matrix-covariate summation convention) roadmap item. Earlier: (v0.4 core: v0.1 GLMM core; v0.2 distributional regression, single-response family roster, newdata prediction delta-method SEs, simulate, confint/anova/diagnose; v0.3 s()/t2() smooths dpar plus homdiag/cs/ar1 covariance structures; v0.4 multivariate models per-response families, gaussian rescor, brms |ID| cross-formula random-effect correlation, matrix-response multinomial, zi/hurdle families full zi/hu formulas). main fit function frm() (cf. brm()/brms). Interfaces can change v1.0. Multivariate design notes: every linear predictor’s Z spans full b vector (sparse), Z column indices b indices |ID| merging column placement; |ID|-linked terms merge one us block whose per-level coefficient vector concatenates component terms. rescor standardizes per-response residuals evaluates one constant correlation matrix (plus log-sigma Jacobian), stays vectorized distributional sigma. Matrix responses (multinomial) use primary_dpars: families whose location predictors mu2..muK receive main formula, individually overridable dpar formulas. Deviations original plan: simulate() implemented numeric R-level simulator per family instead obj$simulate() (see simref note section 4.7) OSA residuals deferred alongside ; RTMBdist wiring deferred families needed (native RTMB densities sufficed); v0.3, gr(=, cov=), ou, toep, propto deferred (ou/toep need numFactor-style coordinate handling), smooth edf reporting summary() deferred. Smooth terms extracted formula top-level reformulas::splitForm runs, splitForm strips s()/t2() regardless specials argument; s()/t2() calls evaluated mgcv’s constructors. v0.4: cumulative ordinal cens()/trunc() moved v0.4.x; fitted/residuals/simulate univariate-now; OBS() applied univariate non-matrix responses, RTMB registers observations deparsed argument expression, identical expressions loop responses silently collide.

title: frmtmb specification
text: glmmTMB one fixed C++ likelihood behind formula front end. frmtmb inverts design: formula compiler. parses brms-style bf() specification intermediate representation (IR), assembles design matrices covariance-structure blocks data, generates RTMB objective closure R. RTMB tapes closure per fit. design unlocks four things current frequentist package offers together: Distributional regression random effects smooths every distributional-parameter (dpar) formula. union gamlss2 (-parameter regression, marginal-likelihood random effects) glmmTMB (random effects, disp zi sub-models). Nonlinear formulas (nl = TRUE) nonlinear parameter full predictor grammar, including random effects smooths. Multivariate joint models different family per response, residual correlation, |ID| random-effect correlation across formulas (glmmTMB issue #1267, open). Custom families plain R functions. brms requires Stan code; glmmTMB requires C++ pull request.

code: build_objective <- function(frame) {   lps       <- frame$linpreds   blocks    <- frame$re_blocks   block_nll <- lapply(blocks, \(bk) covstruct_registry[[bk$covstruct]]$nll)   fam_lpdf  <- lapply(frame$spec$responses, \(r) r$family$lpdf)   y         <- frame$y    function(pars) {     RTMB::getAll(pars, warn = FALSE)     "[<-" <- RTMB::ADoverload("[<-")     nll <- 0     for (bk in blocks)                       # loop over structure, not obs       nll <- nll - block_nll[[...]](b[bk$b_idx], theta[bk$theta_idx], bk$aux)     dparv <- list()     for (lp in lps) {       eta <- drop(lp$X %*% beta[lp$beta_idx])       if (!is.null(lp$Z))      eta <- eta + drop(lp$Z %*% b[lp$b_idx])       if (!is.null(lp$offset)) eta <- eta + lp$offset       dparv[[lp$key]] <- lp$link$inv(eta)     }     for (r in names(y)) {       yobs <- RTMB::OBS(y[[r]])              # free simulate() and OSA       nll  <- nll - sum(w[[r]] * fam_lpdf[[r]](yobs, dpars_for(r, dparv),                                                frame$spec$responses[[r]]$aterms))     }     nll   } }
